info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Miargyri Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Miargyri Produce Details API allows users to add new produce items to the Miargyri catalog. This endpoint facilitates the registration of detailed descriptions and attributes of produce, supporting inventory management and consumer access. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and product catalog systems looking to maintain up-to-date product information. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their product listings and streamline the onboarding of new produce items, ensuring accurate and accessible data for end-users.
